article.story: North Carolina (5-5) at Virginia (5-5), Nov. 21 at 12:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Virginia by 1.5. Against the spread: Virginia 4-6, North Carolina 7-3. How to watch: The CW Key stats Virginia Offense Overall: 364.7 yards per game (81st in FBS) Passing: 213.7 yards per game (84th) Rushing: 151 yards per game (74th) Scoring: 26.9 points per game (78th) Virginia Defense Overall: 335.2 yards per game (38th in FBS) Passing: 186.1 yards per game (29th) Rushing: 149.1 yards per game (81st) Scoring: 21.5 points per game (39th) North Carolina Offense Overall: 346.9 yards per game (100th in FBS) Passing: 232.7 yards per game (57th) Rushing: 114.2 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 25.8 points per game (84th) North Carolina Defense Overall: 369.5 yards per game (79th in FBS) Passing: 219.9 yards per game (81st) Rushing: 149.6 yards per game (82nd) Scoring: 22.1 points per game (47th) North Carolina ranks 21st in FBS in third down percentage, converting 46.4% of the time. North Carolina is 95th in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Virginia's 17th-ranked +6 margin. North Carolina is 6th in the FBS averaging 36.4 penalty yards per game. Virginia is 107th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 88.9% of trips. North Carolina's red zone offense ranks 19th, scoring on 91.7% of red zone opportunities. North Carolina ranks 105th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:35, compared to Virginia's 27th-ranked average of 31:45. Team leaders Virginia Passing: Beau Pribula, 1,733 yards, 15 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jekail Middlebrook, 540 yards on 111 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Dashawn Martin, 431 yards on 30 catches, 7 TDs North Carolina Passing: Billy Edwards Jr., 2,246 yards, 18 TDs, 6 INTs, 65.5 completion percentage Rushing: Benjamin Hall, 425 yards on 79 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jordan Shipp, 703 yards on 57 catches, 4 TDs Last game Virginia won 36-7 over Cal on Nov. 14. Pribula led Virginia with 146 yards on 16-of-24 passing (66.7%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 67 yards. Solomon Beebe had 58 rushing yards on six carries, adding two receptions for 16 yards. Martin put up 59 yards on four catches with one touchdown. North Carolina lost 16-14 to Louisville on Nov. 14. Edwards threw for 120 yards on 10-of-14 attempts (71.4%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Hall carried the ball 10 times for 48 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding one reception for 12 yards. Jelani Thurman had five receptions for 72 yards. Next game Virginia plays at Virginia Tech on Nov. 28. North Carolina hosts NC State on Nov. 28.
